faq.a1: A User Agent is a string of text sent by your web browser to every website you visit, identifying the browser, version, operating system, and device type.
faq.a2: It uses standard pattern matching to identify common real-world user agents. However, user agent strings can be spoofed or modified.
faq.a3: Yes, parsing happens locally in your browser. We do not store your user agent data.
